sources.title: Azure Throttling pattern
sources.version_or_date: Live page; last updated 2026-05-30
sources.confirmed: Describes per-principal and outbound throttling, token buckets, early rejection, and overload signals.
sources.limits: A per-reporter cap alone does not cap cluster-wide traffic; expose suppression counts and preserve representative application diagnostics. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C05.json.

sources.title: Azure Queue-Based Load Leveling pattern
sources.version_or_date: Live page; last updated 2026-06-12
sources.confirmed: Buffers variable producers and controls downstream consumption; warns that sustained excess input grows the queue.
sources.limits: Use only a bounded local-buffer adaptation within scope; sustained overload requires coalescing or dropping, and crashes can lose buffered events. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C05.json.

sources.title: Azure Circuit Breaker pattern
sources.version_or_date: Live page; last updated 2025-03-21
sources.sections_read: Context; state machine; recovery; considerations; footer
sources.confirmed: Stops repeated failing calls and permits limited recovery probes; concurrency and timeout overhead remain relevant.
sources.limits: Set bounded timeouts and probes; do not recursively report every reporting failure, and make diagnostic gaps visible after recovery. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C05.json.

sources.title: Enterprise Integration Patterns — Aggregator
sources.version_or_date: Live page; original core-pattern availability corroborated by the authors' 2003 book entry
sources.confirmed: Separates correlation, completeness, and aggregation decisions; timeout completion is one option.
sources.limits: Bound groups and memory; retain meaningful message distinctions, counts, and timing instead of merging all similar-looking failures. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C05.json.

sources.title: Enterprise Integration Patterns — Idempotent Receiver
sources.version_or_date: Live page; original core-pattern availability corroborated by the authors' 2003 book entry
sources.confirmed: Distinguishes duplicate delivery and explains explicit deduplication or idempotent message semantics.
sources.limits: Delivery identity and semantic grouping identity serve different purposes; bounded deduplication state still needs restart and expiry rules. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C05.json.

sources.title: Enterprise Integration Patterns — Event Message
sources.version_or_date: Live page; original core-pattern availability corroborated by the authors' 2003 book entry
sources.confirmed: Treats events as timely asynchronous notifications and discusses the cost of pursuing guaranteed delivery.
sources.limits: The pattern emphasizes timely notifications; application debugging still requires meaningful details, and durable delivery guarantees must not create overload. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C05.json.
